lessons.title: Lessons for every goal
lessons.intro: Conversation, Business English, IELTS preparation and English for kids — every online course is tailored to your level, schedule and goals.

items.name: Conversation
items.text: Stop translating in your head. Build fluency through relaxed, real conversation on topics you enjoy.

items.name: Business English
items.text: Sound professional in meetings, emails, presentations and job interviews.

items.name: IELTS preparation
items.text: A clear strategy for all four parts of the test, with mock exams and detailed feedback.

items.name: English for kids & teens
items.text: Playful, structured lessons that help children and teenagers love learning English.

prices.title: Simple, honest prices

steps.title: Trial lesson
steps.text: Book a 15-minute trial lesson for $5. We meet, check your level and talk about your goals.

steps.title: Choose a plan
steps.text: Pick the lessons and plan that fit your goals, budget and schedule.

steps.title: Start learning
steps.text: Learn online from anywhere, with a teacher who follows your progress.

items.a: Lessons take place on Zoom or Google Meet. All you need is a phone, tablet or computer with internet. Your teacher shares materials on screen and sends notes after each lesson.

items.q: How much is the trial lesson?
items.a: The trial lesson is 15 minutes and costs $5. It's a relaxed way to meet your teacher, check your level and plan your lessons — with no obligation to continue.
Every level is welcome — from complete beginners to advanced learners. We check your level during the trial lesson.

items.q: Can I study with a native English speaker?
items.a: Yes. Our team includes native English-speaking teachers. Just tell us your preference when you book.
Yes — please let us know at least 24 hours before the lesson. [Edit with your own policy.]
